about: The store takes passes that run at once. A point set is kept once, by the first to keep it: a second fold of the same points is read back as the first, and lands no head of its own.
A file named by the digest of its bytes lands whole, once, whoever lands it: it is written aside and renamed into place, so a second landing changes nothing and no reader meets half of it.

cases.name: one point set kept twice, with different timings in its bytes

red was: two lanes' passes kept one point set at once and every pass refused on the fork; a blob landed twice crashed a pass
